description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with the Android build system, including functions to retrieve paths for build directories, environment variables, and related resources.

methods.name: GetTop
methods.description: Returns the full pathname of the Android build root directory.

methods.name: GetHostOutDir
methods.description: Returns the full pathname of the Android host output directory.

methods.name: GetOutDir
methods.description: Returns the full pathname of the Android build output directory.

methods.name: GetHostBin
methods.description: Computes the full pathname to the host binary directory.

methods.name: GetProductOut
methods.description: Returns the full pathname to the target/product directory.

methods.name: GetTargetNativeTestPath
methods.description: Returns the full pathname to the target native test directory.

methods.name: GetTargetSystemBin
methods.description: Returns the full pathname to the target system/bin directory.

methods.name: GetHostLibraryPath
methods.description: Returns the full pathname to the host java library output directory.

methods.name: GetTestAppPath
methods.description: Returns the full pathname to the test app build output directory.
